realizes.rationale: Keeps the mounted page opened location groups in local state through toggleGroup/openGroup, so subject reads do not reset them. The hook also keeps the Worklist flag and closes it when setChosen selects family context. The remembered code-context preference and width-derived diff layout live outside this hook; it owns no full-file disclosure, open expression path or closePath focus return.
Holds the tree intent: a number that goes up with every selection and the flag whether that selection keeps the tree. `beginSelection` is the only writer, and the initial intent does not keep.

The request a selection or a refresh leaves: the element that had focus, the number of the tree intent current when it was made (`after`), whether it only scrolls (`scrollOnly`), and whether an answer has arrived since (`answered`). The effect reads these fields together with the external tree intent's id, the payload identity and the catalogue's loading state: it leaves the request alone unless a later render's tree intent number exceeds the recorded one, waits while the catalogue loads and returns while the subject is pending, so the request's own fields do not decide consumption alone.
